title_zh: 婚礼致辞只讲双方愿意分享的事

scenario.label_zh: 确认婚礼致辞内容边界
scenario.goal_zh: 确定致辞中的感谢和祝愿，并同意删去私密故事及不切实际的承诺

context_zh: 新郎奥斯卡和姐姐妮娜讨论她准备在婚礼上说的话。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: I have written a short toast for your wedding. Is there anything you would rather I left out?

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Please skip the story about our first kiss. Ana would prefer to keep that private.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: Of course. I mainly want to say how much happiness you bring each other.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: That is lovely. Could you also thank Aunt Rosa for being so generous with her time? She made all the decorations.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: I will. Are you comfortable with me talking about what marriage means to you?

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Yes, but please do not say we will agree on everything forever. We certainly do not agree on everything now.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: Fair point. I will wish you patience and plenty of laughter instead.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: I am grateful you are doing this. Keep it under two minutes, and it will be perfect.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: Two minutes, a thank-you to Rosa, and no private stories. I will make those changes tonight.
